title: Skills
summary: Four semantic records now explain taxonomy, individual checks, group checks and whole-section checks, with exact sources and named cross-component routes.
body: Receives JD requirements, selected work and candidate tools; produces categorized JD-relevant skills. The planned application contract is unchanged. Jev classifies individual terms; Python assembles approved groups. Read the child index and open only the relevant record, then follow its named links. Semantic migration is ready for user review; this is not a claim that current application code enforces the agreement.
